description: Orchestrates multi-omics data integration, biomarker stratification, targeted therapy selection, and longitudinal ctDNA resistance monitoring.

inputs.name: genomic_variants
inputs.description: List of somatic and germline genomic alterations with VAF and CNV calls

inputs.name: biomarker_panel
inputs.description: Composite biomarker metrics including TMB, MSI, HRD, and PD-L1 scores

inputs.name: clinical_phenotype
inputs.description: Histology, cancer staging, organ function parameters, and prior treatment history

inputs.name: pharmacogenomic_profile
inputs.description: Diplotypes for metabolic enzymes and transporters (CYP, DPYD, TPMT, UGT1A1)

inputs.name: candidate_regimens
inputs.description: Candidate therapeutic options for precision ranking

inputs.name: longitudinal_ctdna
inputs.description: Serial liquid biopsy time points for MRD kinetics analysis

outputs.name: actionable_targets
outputs.description: ESCAT and AMP/ASCO/CAP tiered biomarker targets

outputs.name: ranked_therapies
outputs.description: Multi-criteria ranked therapeutic recommendations with efficacy and toxicity indices

outputs.name: resistance_risks
outputs.description: Predicted bypass pathways and emergent resistance mechanisms

outputs.name: mrd_protocol
outputs.description: ctDNA clearance kinetics, molecular response status, and test intervals

outputs.name: executive_summary
outputs.description: Narrative briefing for molecular tumor boards
